prompt: Read scenario.md and the files under {{fixtures}} (home\AI and home\Repositories there stand in for ~/AI and ~/Repositories). I want every AI client to load the incident-response skill from my company's private repo git@ssh.example.com:acme/company-ai, where it lives at skills/incident-response. I already have a clone of it at ~/Repositories/company-ai. Answer in your reply: the exact registry change and the command to run afterwards.

pass:
In ~/AI/local.yaml add:
```yaml
collections:
  work:
    path: ~/Repositories/company-ai
    skills:
      - incident-response
```
Not external-skills.yaml: that file is public. Then run ./scripts/sync.sh.
Register Repositories\company-ai as a local.yaml collection listing incident-response, then run `./scripts/sync.sh`.
fail:
Add to external-skills.yaml:
- name: incident-response
  type: git
  source: git@ssh.example.com:acme/company-ai
  path: skills/incident-response
Then run ./scripts/sync.sh. You could also list ~/Repositories/company-ai in local.yaml.
Copy skills/incident-response into ~/AI/skills and restart your AI client.
